pli-tv-bi-vb-pc3:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc3:1.2: tena kho pana samayena dve bhikkhuniyo anabhiratiyā pīḷitā ovarakaṃ pavisitvā talaghātakaṃ karonti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc3:1.3: bhikkhuniyo tena saddena upadhāvitā tā bhikkhuniyo etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc3:1.4: kissa tumhe ayye purisena saddhiṃ sampadussathā 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc3:1.5: na mayaṃ ayye purisena saddhiṃ sampadussāmā 'ti bhikkhunīnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc3:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā tā ujjhāyanti --pa--: kathaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc3:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo talaghātakaṃ karontīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc3:1.11: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo talaghātakaṃ karissanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc3:2.2: samphassaṃ sādiyantī antamaso uppalapattena pi muttakaraṇe pahāraṃ deti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
